description: This file defines the RssReaderActivity class, an Android activity that displays an RSS feed using a list. It sets up a list view with data from an RSS feed URL and handles item clicks to open news items in a browser.

classes.name: RssReaderActivity
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that displays RSS feed items in a list and opens links on item clicks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout and list adapter, and attaches an item click listener.
